notes.title: v2.0, Game Engine Version Update
notes.notes:
This is the first major change we've done in a while, we've updated the version of the game engine for this build. We've also fixed a few small typos, audios, and non-critical bugs. Any saved games should still work. But please let us know if you experience any problems at all. Have fun!

Chaz Lewis
Lead Designer

notes.title: Testing complete and release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
Good news! Testing has now been completed.

And we have confirmed the release date! The game will be available on the 12th of November. This week!

It will also be available with a 15% discount for the first week. So be quick!

Many thanks to you all. We hope you will enjoy the experience.

Enjoy and goodluck!
-Chaz and Andrea
